purpose: E0 model diagnostics on a public Go2W model; no RL or hardware claim
control_period_s: same as physics timestep; quasi-static diagnostic controller
joint_and_motor_limits: upstream MJCF; no verified hardware torque-speed curve

collision_variants.upstream: two identical collidable mesh geometries on each wheel
collision_variants.single_collision: first wheel mesh made visual-only; second retains upstream six-dimensional friction contact

note: These are development gates for this low-speed test object, not universal safety or research-success thresholds. Failed trials remain in the results.
